title: Loi n°2025-019 relative à l'évaluation environnementale et sociale
citation: Loi n° 2025-019/P.R du 2 juin 2025 relative à l'évaluation environnementale et sociale, Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie n° 1585 du 15 juillet 2025, p. 619
evidence: No official page states an entry-into-force date: Art. 45 reads "La présente loi sera exécutée comme loi d'Etat et publiée au Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie." and the text has no commencement clause. The law is signed "Fait à Nouakchott, le 02 juin 2025"; the portal lists the gazette as "Journal officiel n°2025-1585 du 15/07/2025" (https://msgg.gov.mr/fr/droit-mauritanien/le-journal-officiel.html, opened 2026-11-03). The record is dated the gazette date, 2025-07-15, as the date of the published text; this is not a stated entry into force.
notes: Mapped to F2 (the existing register row said F7): the act sets the environmental and social assessment regime for projects, plans and programmes; it is not a climate or reporting duty. Art. 44 repeals prior contrary provisions, 'notamment' Loi n° 2000-045 (mr-loi-2000-045), and keeps Décret n° 2004-094 and Décret n° 2007-105 (mr-decret-2004-094, mr-decret-2007-105) in force until the implementing decree of this law is adopted; no such decree was found on the portal on 2026-11-03. One record: French text of the gazette issue, cut from page 3 (title) to the signatures (pdftotext in two column crops per page, running headers and bare page numbers dropped). Arabic (the official language): the Arabic gazette issue is served at https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2025/mauritanie-jo-2025-1585-ar.pdf, but its text layer does not extract faithfully with pdftotext (plain, -layout and -raw all tried on 2026-11-03): words come out in visual order and the digits are wrong, for example the index line of Loi n°2025-019 reads 'قانون رقم 350-0301' for 2025-019. No Arabic record is stored; the Arabic issue needs OCR or a source with a clean text layer. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr (portal has French and Arabic only) and environnement.gov.mr (lois page lists French documents only).

title: Loi n°2000-045 du 26 juillet 2000 portant Code de l'environnement

notes: Link only: the gazette issue is a scanned image with no text layer (pdftotext returns 24 characters for the whole file), and OCR is not part of the repository's fetch recipes, so no text is stored. The Ministry of the Environment lists the code as a PDF at http://www.environnement.gov.mr/fr/images/reglementations/LOI_Code_de_l_Environnement.pdf (not used, no licence row for that host). status_note: Repealed 'notamment' by Art. 44 of Loi n° 2025-019; the portal list shows no repeal annotation on this entry on 2026-11-03.

title: Loi n°2020-007 du 4 juin 2020 relative à la protection du consommateur
citation: Loi n° 2020-007 du 4 juin 2020 relative à la protection du consommateur, Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie n° 1465 du 15 juillet 2020, p. 480
evidence: Art. 91: "La présente loi prend effet à partir de 6 mois de sa date de publication." The portal lists the gazette as "Journal officiel n°2020-1465 du 15/07/2020" (https://msgg.gov.mr/fr/droit-mauritanien/le-journal-officiel.html, opened 2026-11-03), so six months from publication is 2021-01-15 (the date is computed here, not printed on any page).
notes: Umbrella consumer law for goods and services (information, abusive practices, associations); a search of the stored text for 'environnement', 'allégation', 'mensonger' and 'trompeur' found no provision on environmental claims, so it is the umbrella only. Implemented in part by mr-decret-2024-027. One record: French text of the gazette issue (two column crops per page, running headers and bare page numbers dropped). Arabic (the official language): the Arabic gazette issue is served at https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2020/mauritanie-jo-2020-1465-ar.pdf, but its text layer does not extract faithfully with pdftotext (plain, -layout and -raw all tried on 2026-11-03): words come out in visual order and the digits are wrong, for example the index line of Loi n°2025-019 reads 'قانون رقم 350-0301' for 2025-019. No Arabic record is stored; the Arabic issue needs OCR or a source with a clean text layer. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr (French and Arabic only).

title: Décret n°2024-027 du 20 février 2024 fixant les conditions et modalités d'agrément des associations de défense des consommateurs
citation: Décret n° 2024-027 du 20 février 2024, Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie n° 1559 du 15 juin 2024, p. 480
evidence: No official page states an entry-into-force date: Art. 12 says the decree 'sera publié au Journal Officiel' and Art. 10 refers to 'son entrée en vigueur' without a date. The portal lists the gazette as "Journal officiel n°2024-1559 du 15/06/2024" (opened 2026-11-03); the record is dated that gazette date, not a stated entry into force.
notes: Implements Art. 74 of Loi n° 2020-007 (mr-loi-2020-007) and repeals Décret n° 2003-030; it governs approval of consumer associations, not environmental claims. One record: French text. Arabic (the official language): the Arabic gazette issue is served at https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2024/mauritanie-jo-2024-1559-ar.pdf, but its text layer does not extract faithfully with pdftotext (plain, -layout and -raw all tried on 2026-11-03): words come out in visual order and the digits are wrong, for example the index line of Loi n°2025-019 reads 'قانون رقم 350-0301' for 2025-019. No Arabic record is stored; the Arabic issue needs OCR or a source with a clean text layer. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr (French and Arabic only).

title: Loi n°2018-017 du 13 mars 2018 relative à la publicité
citation: Loi n° 2018-017 du 13 mars 2018 relative à la publicité, Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie n° 1410 du 15 avril 2018
evidence: No in-force date read: the gazette text was not stored (see notes). The portal lists the gazette as "Journal officiel n°2018-1410 du 15/04/2018" (opened 2026-11-03).
notes: Advertising law with a ban on misleading advertising ('publicité mensongère ou trompeuse') and on advertising for products harmful to the environment; it is the nearest Mauritanian rule to a green-claims duty. Link only: the French gazette issue (40 pages, several laws and decrees) extracts with scrambled article order in every pdftotext mode tried (plain, and two column crops per page: article numbers repeat and run 66, 66, 66, 64 and so on), so no faithful text could be cut. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr.
